findings.finding: Setup step omits the required permission
findings.recommendation: Add the permission name and link to the configuration screen.
findings.evidence: The next screenshot assumes the permission is enabled, but the preceding steps never mention it.

findings.finding: Two sections use different names for the same workspace role
findings.evidence: The role is called “editor” in the table and “workspace contributor” in the paragraph below it.

findings.finding: The troubleshooting command needs platform variants
findings.recommendation: Confirm the supported shells, then provide macOS, Linux, and Windows forms.
findings.evidence: The current command uses syntax that is not portable across the supported platforms.

findings.finding: Introductory paragraph repeats the page title
findings.recommendation: Open with the outcome the reader will achieve.
findings.evidence: The original sentence added no information beyond the heading.

findings.finding: A screenshot may expose a sample email address
findings.recommendation: Inspect the source image and replace any identifying value with synthetic data.
findings.evidence: The visible text is small, so the original asset needs a full-resolution check.

findings.finding: Link text does not describe its destination
findings.recommendation: Replace “click here” with the destination page name.
findings.evidence: Descriptive link text is clearer when navigating by links or using assistive technology.
